a.lede: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving.
a.title: Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%

b.lede: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.
b.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
